correctness.rationale: For k>=4, 0<theta<1, lambda>0, reconstruct the Kissel–Külske–Rozikov positive boundary-law equations u=a(1+u^k+theta v^k)/(1+u^k+v^k), v=a(1+theta u^k+v^k)/(1+u^k+v^k), a=lambda^(1/k). Symmetric u=v=r branch has strictly increasing a(r). For u≠v the source linear elimination is reversible; q=v/u>1, D=sum_{0..k}q^j,E=sum_{0..k-1}q^j,C=sum_{1..k-1}q^j and H=C-theta D give u^k=1/H and lambda=D^k/(E^k H). H>0 iff theta<(k-1)/(k+1) and 1<q<q_theta, by monotonic sinh((k-1)x)/sinh((k+1)x), q=e^(2x). Strict derivative positivity follows the universal coefficient identity N_theta/(q-1)=(1-theta)D P_k+k q^(k-1) R_k with all P,R coefficients >0. Endpoint at q=1 gives lambda_c=((k+1)/k)^k/(k-1-(k+1)theta); endpoint H=0 gives infinity. Precisely one nonsymmetric pair exists iff lambda>lambda_c; plus unique symmetric branch gives exact count 1/3. Independently expanded the claimed polynomial factorization over rational/symbolic theta for k=4..12, verified representative reconstructions in the original system; unbounded conclusion rests on coefficient formula.

These are major structural constraints on a natural tree Gibbs specification.
